annotation.title_clean: Update to Singapore's National AI Strategy: Refreshed Priorities to Harness AI for the Public Good (Factsheet)
annotation.title_en: Update to Singapore's National AI Strategy: Refreshed Priorities to Harness AI for the Public Good (Factsheet)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (Singapore)
annotation.summary_en: Factsheet from Singapore's MDDI announcing an update to the National AI Strategy (NAIS 2.0), setting out 10 refreshed priorities across enablers such as industry, government, research, talent, compute, data, trusted environment and international leadership. It emphasises sectoral AI Missions, adoption, workforce readiness and layered governance; no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten refreshed priorities across NAIS enablers, including renamed 'Ecosystem Integration'.
National AI Missions in Advanced Manufacturing, Financial Services, Connectivity and Healthcare.
Over S$1 billion committed to public AI research and talent 2025-2030 under NAIRD Plan.
Strengthen layered AI governance, sector-specific risk management and AI testing and assurance.
National AI Council chaired by PM Wong established February 2026; Singapore to chair ASEAN in 2027.
